meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装、发现并接入 HyperFrames 组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用 HyperFrames 开发,需要装组件或开发新组件
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build with HyperFrames and need component management or authoring

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用 hyperframes add 安装积木或组件,用 hyperframes catalog 搜索;装完告诉你写入了哪些文件并给出需要贴进 index.html 的片段。它也能读取 hyperframes.json 里的安装路径配置。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或查找 HyperFrames 的积木/组件,或要把已装部件接入 index.html、处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 积木,用 hyperframes add
say.note: 会安装并在终端输出可粘贴的片段。

say.text: 用 hyperframes catalog 搜索“逐行揭示标题”的积木
say.note: 会按语义排名返回匹配项。

say.text: 把已安装的 grain-overlay 组件接进当前项目的 index.html
say.note: 会读取组件文件并指导粘贴。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use hyperframes add to install blocks or components and hyperframes catalog to search; after installing, it tells you which files were written and gives a snippet to paste into index.html. It can also read install path configuration from hyperframes.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install or discover HyperFrames blocks/components, wire an installed item into index.html, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block using hyperframes add
say_en.note: Installs and prints a paste-ready snippet.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a block that reveals a headline line by line
Wire the installed grain-overlay component into the current project's index.html
say_en.note: Reads the component file and guides pasting.
